captions.text: Everything taken from the resume is waiting for your review.
Your contact details are only used on resumes and letters you create.
They're never sent to an AI provider.
Check each item, and fix anything that's wrong with edit.
Only approved information is used to score jobs and build resumes.
Everything here looks right, so we'll approve each item.
As you approve them, they move from needs review to approved, until the whole profile is ready to use.
Imported resumes start as drafts, so approve the resume too.
Open Resumes, and click approve resume.
